Endpoint

PATCH {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}

Updates an existing content customization. Only provided fields are updated; omitted fields retain their current values.

Authentication

Type: Bearer token

  • Required scope (one of):

    • scope: hypr:cc:applications (with principal = CC_ADMIN_RPAPP_ID)

    • scope: hypr:affirm:admin

    • scope: hypr:affirm:writeContentCustomization

Request Headers

Header Required Value
Content-Type Yes application/json
Authorization Yes Bearer

Path parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
contentCustomizationId string Yes Content customization ID (numeric string) to update.

Request Body

Content-Type: application/json

Request body is a BaseContentCustomizationDTO. Send only the fields you want to change.

Request body schema

{
  "displayName": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "contentMap": {},
  "stylePaletteMap": {}
}

Field descriptions

Field Type Required Description
displayName string No New display name. Omit to keep current. If provided, must be non-blank. Max length: 100.
description string No New description. Omit to keep current.
contentMap object No New per-screen content. Omit to keep current. Partial updates may replace the entire contentMap; see implementation. See contentMap below.
stylePaletteMap object No New style palette. Omit to keep current. Partial updates may replace the entire stylePaletteMap; see implementation. See stylePaletteMap below.

stylePaletteMap (style / theme)

stylePaletteMap controls the visual theme of the IDV flow: header, logo, typography, progress bar, buttons, inputs, and video area. All keys are optional; omitted keys fall back to defaults. Values are typically CSS-friendly strings (e.g. hex colors like #ffffff, sizes like 16px, 1rem).

Layout and header

Key Type Description
fullScreenExperience boolean Whether the IDV experience uses a full-screen layout.
headerBackground string Header background color (e.g. #ffffff).
logoWidth string Logo width (e.g. 120px, 8rem).
logoHeight string Logo height (e.g. 40px, 2.5rem).

Body and headings

Key Type Description
bodyContentColor string Default body text color.
bodyContentSize string Default body font size.
headingContentColor string Heading text color.
headingContentSize string Heading font size.

Progress bar

Key Type Description
colorProgressTrack string Background color of the progress track.
colorProgressIndicator string Color of the progress indicator/fill.

Primary button (main CTAs)

Key Type Description
primaryButtonBackgroundColor string Background color.
primaryButtonTextColor string Text color.
primaryButtonHoverBackgroundColor string Background on hover.
primaryButtonFocusBackgroundColor string Background when focused.
primaryButtonBorder string Border (e.g. 1px solid).
primaryButtonBorderColor string Default border color.
primaryButtonHoverBorderColor string Border color on hover.
primaryButtonFocusBorderColor string Border color when focused.
primaryButtonBorderRadius string Border radius (e.g. 4px).
primaryButtonDisabledBackgroundColor string Background when disabled.
primaryButtonDisabledTextColor string Text color when disabled.
primaryButtonDisabledBorderColor string Border color when disabled.

Secondary button

Key Type Description
secondaryButtonBackgroundColor string Background color.
secondaryButtonTextColor string Text color.
secondaryButtonHoverBackgroundColor string Background on hover.
secondaryButtonFocusBackgroundColor string Background when focused.
secondaryButtonBorder string Border.
secondaryButtonBorderColor string Default border color.
secondaryButtonHoverBorderColor string Border color on hover.
secondaryButtonFocusBorderColor string Border color when focused.
secondaryButtonBorderRadius string Border radius.
secondaryButtonDisabledBackgroundColor string Background when disabled.
secondaryButtonDisabledTextColor string Text color when disabled.
secondaryButtonDisabledBorderColor string Border color when disabled.

Tertiary button

Key Type Description
tertiaryButtonBackgroundColor string Background color.
tertiaryButtonTextColor string Text color.
tertiaryButtonHoverBackgroundColor string Background on hover.
tertiaryButtonFocusBackgroundColor string Background when focused.
tertiaryButtonBorder string Border.
tertiaryButtonBorderColor string Default border color.
tertiaryButtonHoverBorderColor string Border color on hover.
tertiaryButtonFocusBorderColor string Border color when focused.
tertiaryButtonBorderRadius string Border radius.
tertiaryButtonDisabledBackgroundColor string Background when disabled.
tertiaryButtonDisabledTextColor string Text color when disabled.
tertiaryButtonDisabledBorderColor string Border color when disabled.

Input fields

Key Type Description
inputBackgroundColor string Input background color.
inputContentColor string Input text color.
inputBorderColor string Input border color.

Video area (e.g. document upload / instructions video)

Key Type Description
videoLogoWidth string Logo width in the video section.
videoHeadingContentColor string Heading color in the video section.
videoHeadingContentSize string Heading font size in the video section.

The server uses stylePaletteMap to generate a CSS stylesheet (e.g. via the stylesheet endpoint). Only keys you override need to be present; the rest use default theme values.

contentMap (per-screen copy and labels)

contentMap holds copy and labels for each IDV screen. It is an object whose keys are screen names; each screen key maps to a screen content object. All keys are optional; only screens you customize need entries.

Screen keys in contentMap

Key Description
instructionsScreen Initial instructions and step labels (e.g. verify phone, verify location, verify ID).
consentScreen Consent screen text and loading placeholder.
loginIdentifierScreen Login identifier step: title, description, placeholders, button labels, error messages.
phoneNumberOrEmailScreen Phone/email verification: titles and descriptions for phone vs email vs both, placeholders, hints, OTP disclaimers, error messages.
otpScreen OTP entry: button labels (continue, verify, resend), error messages (code not sent, mismatch, invalid), success messages.
locationScreen Location verification: button labels, error messages, success messages, screen-specific copy.
verifiedCredentialScreen Verified credential step: card header/footer, button labels, error messages, screen-specific content.
idv1Screen IDV1 document/biometric step: titles, descriptions, button labels, error messages.
idv1AwaitScreen IDV1 await/processing screen.
idv1ReportScreen IDV1 report/result screen.
documentUploadVideoScreen Document upload video: button labels, error messages, screen-specific content.
awaitScreen Generic await/processing screen.
approverPreVerifyScreen Approver pre-verification screen.
approverAttestScreen Approver attestation: button labels and screen-specific content.
approverAttestationResultsScreen Approver attestation results.

Structure of each screen object

Each screen value is an object that can contain:

Key Type Description
cardHeader object title, description – shown at the top of the card.
cardFooter object caption1, caption2 – optional footer captions.
buttonLabels object Screen-specific button text (e.g. continueButton, verifyButton, resendButton where applicable).
errorMessages object Screen-specific error messages (e.g. unknown, invalidPhoneNumber, codeMismatchTitle). Keys vary by screen.
successMessages object Screen-specific success messages (e.g. on OTP or location screens). Optional; not all screens have it.
fieldRelatedContent object Placeholders and labels tied to form fields (e.g. loginIdentifierPlaceholder, phoneNumberPlaceholder). Optional.
screenSpecificContent object Extra copy specific to that screen (e.g. step labels on instructions, verification titles on phone/email). Keys vary by screen.

Example: contentMap.instructionsScreen can have cardHeader (title, description), buttonLabels.continueButton, errorMessages (e.g. fetchInstructionsFailed, loadingInstructionsError), and screenSpecificContent with keys like verifyPhoneStepLabel, verifyLocationStepLabel, verifyIdDocumentationStepLabel, loadingPlaceholder. Other screens follow the same pattern with their own button, error, and screen-specific keys. Omitted screens or omitted keys within a screen use server defaults. String values may be sanitized (e.g. XSS) when stored.

Response

The response body is the updated ContentCustomizationDTO (full object including id).

Content-Type: application/json

Response body schema

{
  "id": "string",
  "displayName": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "contentMap": {},
  "stylePaletteMap": {}
}

Response fields match the request; contentMap and stylePaletteMap use the same structure as in stylePaletteMap and contentMap above.

Status codes

Code Description
200 OK. Request succeeded; response body contains the updated content customization.
400 Bad Request. Invalid request body.
401 Unauthorized. Authentication required.
403 Forbidden. Insufficient permissions.
404 Not Found. No content customization with the given ID, or ID is not a valid numeric string.
500 Internal Server Error. Unexpected server error.

Notes

  • contentCustomizationId in the path must match an existing content customization (valid numeric ID).

  • Content and style values may be sanitized (e.g. XSS) before storage.

item.description:
Overview

The Content Customization API provides endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting identity verification (IDV) content customization kits. Content customizations define display text, labels, and styling (colors, fonts, buttons) for the IDV user experience. They can be attached to verification flows via contentCustomizationId.

Base path: {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization

What are Content Customizations?

A content customization kit includes:

  1. displayName – Name for the kit (e.g. for admin UI)

  2. description – Optional description

  3. contentMap – Per-screen text: instructions, consent, login identifier, phone/email, OTP, location, verified credential, IDV1, document upload, await, approver screens, etc.

  4. stylePaletteMap – Theming: header/logo, body/heading colors and sizes, progress bar, primary/secondary/tertiary button styles, input styles, and related options

Common Use Cases

  • Branding – Match IDV screens to your organization’s look and feel

  • Copy – Customize instructions, button labels, and error/success messages per screen

  • Theming – Control colors, fonts, and layout via stylePaletteMap

  • Reuse – Attach one content customization to multiple verification flows via contentCustomizationId

Endpoints

Method Endpoint Description
POST {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization Create a new content customization
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization List all content customizations
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/defaults Get default HYPR content customization (default copy and style)
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/defaults/style Get default HYPR style customizations only
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId} Get a single content customization by ID
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}/stylesheet Get structured stylesheet palettes (desktop + mobile)
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId} Update an existing content customization
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}/metadata Update kit metadata only (displayName/description)
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}/screens List screens available for this kit
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}/screens/{screenName} Get screen content JSON for one screen
PUT {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}/screens/{screenName} Replace screen content JSON for one screen
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId} Delete a content customization by ID
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization Delete all content customizations (admin-only)
PUT {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}/duplicate Duplicate a content customization

Create Content Customization

POST {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization

Creates a new content customization. Request body is BaseContentCustomizationDTO (displayName, description, contentMap, stylePaletteMap). Response is the created ContentCustomizationDTO (includes id). Returns 201 on success.

List All Content Customizations

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization

Returns an array of all content customization objects. No query parameters.

Get Default Content Customization

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/defaults

Returns the default HYPR content customization (default copy and style). Useful as a template or for reverting to defaults.

Get Default Style Customizations

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/defaults/style

Returns the default HYPR stylePaletteMap only. Useful when you want a style template without pulling default copy.

Get Content Customization by ID

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}

Returns a single content customization by ID. Path parameter contentCustomizationId must be a valid numeric ID. Returns 404 if not found.

Get Content Customization Stylesheet

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}/stylesheet

Returns a structured stylesheet representation derived from the kit’s stylePaletteMap (desktop + mobile palettes). Response is application/json.

Update Content Customization

PATCH {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}

Updates an existing content customization. Request body is BaseContentCustomizationDTO; only provided fields are updated. Returns the updated ContentCustomizationDTO. Returns 404 if the ID is invalid or not found.

Update Content Customization Metadata

PATCH {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}/metadata

Updates only displayName / description (no contentMap / stylePaletteMap).

Delete Content Customization

DELETE {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}

Deletes a content customization by ID. Response body is the deleted content customization object. Verification flows that referenced this kit have their contentCustomizationId set to null. Returns 404 if the ID is invalid or not found.

Delete All Content Customizations

DELETE {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization

Deletes all content customizations. Returns 204 No Content on success.

Duplicate Content Customization

PUT {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/content-customization/{contentCustomizationId}/duplicate

Duplicates an existing kit and returns the newly-created kit with a new id.

Screen Content Operations

  • GET .../{contentCustomizationId}/screens lists screen names available for the kit.
  • GET .../{contentCustomizationId}/screens/{screenName} returns one screen’s content JSON.
  • PUT .../{contentCustomizationId}/screens/{screenName} replaces one screen’s content JSON.

Authentication

All endpoints require a Bearer token. Required scope depends on the operation:

  • Write (POST, PATCH, DELETE): One of scope: hypr:cc:applications (with principal = CC_ADMIN_RPAPP_ID), scope: hypr:affirm:admin, or scope: hypr:affirm:writeContentCustomization.

  • Read (GET list, GET by id, GET defaults, GET stylesheet): One of scope: hypr:cc:applications (with principal = CC_ADMIN_RPAPP_ID), scope: hypr:affirm:admin, scope: hypr:affirm:readContentCustomization, or scope: hypr:affirm:writeContentCustomization.

Response and Error Format

  • Success responses use Content-Type: application/json.

  • Errors use Content-Type: application/problem+json (RFC 7807). Typical status codes: 400 (Bad Request), 401 (Unauthorized), 403 (Forbidden), 404 (Not Found), 500 (Internal Server Error).

Related Documentation

  • Verification Flows API overview – Attach a content customization to a flow via contentCustomizationId.

  • Individual endpoint docs: Create, Get all, Get defaults, Get by ID, Get stylesheet, Update, Delete (Content Customization API Postman).

Creates a new identity verification OIDC client config.

Request Headers

Header Required Value
Content-Type Yes application/json
Authorization Yes Bearer

Request Body

Content-Type: application/json

Request body is the create DTO (e.g. CreateIdentityVerificationOIDCClientConfigDto). Required fields: displayName, authorizationUrl, tokenUrl, rpBaseUrl, clientId. Optional: userInfoUrl, logoutUrl, jwksUrl, clientSecret, userNameClaimAttribute, pkceEnabled, additionalScopesOnAuthReq, resource, genericParameters.

Request body schema

{
  "displayName": "string",
  "authorizationUrl": "string",
  "tokenUrl": "string",
  "userInfoUrl": "string",
  "logoutUrl": "string",
  "jwksUrl": "string",

  "clientId": "string",

  "userNameClaimAttribute": "string",
  "pkceEnabled": true,
  "additionalScopesOnAuthReq": "string",
  "resource": "string",
  "genericParameters": {}
}

Field descriptions

Field Type Required Description
displayName string Yes Display name for the config.
authorizationUrl string Yes OIDC authorization endpoint URL. Must be a valid URL.
tokenUrl string Yes OIDC token endpoint URL. Must be a valid URL.
userInfoUrl string No OIDC userinfo endpoint URL.
logoutUrl string No RP-initiated logout URL.
jwksUrl string No JWKS URL.
rpBaseUrl string Yes Relying party base URL (e.g. https://myhyprrp.com/). Must be a valid URL.
clientId string Yes OAuth client ID from the authorization server.
clientSecret string No OAuth client secret. Stored encrypted.
userNameClaimAttribute string No OIDC claim to map to username. Default: sub.
pkceEnabled boolean No Whether PKCE is enabled. Default: false.
additionalScopesOnAuthReq string No Comma-separated scopes for the authorization request.
resource string No RFC 8707 resource parameter.
genericParameters object No Additional parameters for the authorization request.

Response

On success the response body is the created OIDC client config (includes the generated id). clientSecret is redacted in the response.

Content-Type: application/json

Response body schema

Same structure as Get OIDC client config; includes id and all configured fields. clientSecret is a redacted placeholder.

Code Description
200 OK. Request succeeded; response body contains the new OIDC client config with id.
400 Bad Request. Invalid request body (e.g. missing required fields or invalid URLs).
401 Unauthorized. Authentication required.
403 Forbidden. Insufficient permissions.
500 Internal Server Error. Unexpected server error.

item.description:
Overview

The Identity Verification OIDC Client Config API provides endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting OIDC (OpenID Connect) client configurations used by identity verification (IDV). These configs define how IDV integrates with an external identity provider (e.g. for requester or approver login). They can be referenced by verification flows via oidcClientConfigId.

Base path: {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc

What are OIDC Client Configs?

An OIDC client config includes:

  1. displayName – Label for the config (e.g. for admin UI)

  2. authorizationUrl – OIDC authorization endpoint URL

  3. tokenUrl – OIDC token endpoint URL

  4. userInfoUrl – OIDC userinfo endpoint URL (optional)

  5. logoutUrl – RP-initiated logout URL (optional)

  6. jwksUrl – JWKS URL for key resolution (optional)

  7. rpBaseUrl – Relying party base URL (used to build redirect/callback URLs)

  8. clientId – OAuth client ID issued by the authorization server

  9. clientSecret – OAuth client secret (stored encrypted; redacted in API responses)

  10. userNameClaimAttribute – OIDC claim to map to username (default: sub)

  11. pkceEnabled – Whether PKCE is enabled

  12. additionalScopesOnAuthReq – Comma-separated scopes for the authorization request (optional)

  13. resource – RFC 8707 resource parameter (optional)

  14. genericParameters – Additional parameters for the authorization request (optional)

Common Use Cases

  • Requester / approver login – Configure OIDC so users sign in with an external IdP before starting or approving a verification.

  • Multiple IdPs – Create several OIDC configs and attach the appropriate one per verification flow.

  • Reuse – Reference one OIDC config from multiple verification flows via oidcClientConfigId.

Endpoints

Method Endpoint Description
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc List all OIDC client configs
POST {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc Create a new OIDC client config
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc/{id} Get a single OIDC client config by ID
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc Update an existing OIDC client config
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc/{id} Delete an OIDC client config by ID

List All OIDC Client Configs

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc

Returns an array of all OIDC client config objects. Secret values are redacted in responses.

Create OIDC Client Config

POST {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc

Creates a new OIDC client config. Request body is the create DTO (e.g. displayName, authorizationUrl, tokenUrl, userInfoUrl, clientId, clientSecret, rpBaseUrl, etc.). Response is the created config (includes id). Returns 200 on success.

Get OIDC Client Config by ID

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc/{id}

Returns a single OIDC client config by ID. Path parameter id must be a valid numeric ID. Returns 404 if not found. Secret values are redacted.

Update OIDC Client Config

PATCH {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc

Updates an existing OIDC client config. Request body is the full DTO including id; only provided non-blank fields are updated. Returns the updated config. Returns 404 if the ID is invalid or not found.

Delete OIDC Client Config

DELETE {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/oidc/{id}

Deletes an OIDC client config by ID. Response body is the deleted config. Returns 404 if the ID is invalid or not found.

Authentication

All endpoints require a Bearer token. Required scope depends on the operation:

  • Write (POST create, PATCH update, DELETE): One of scope: hypr:cc:applications (with principal = CC_ADMIN_RPAPP_ID), scope: hypr:affirm:admin, or scope: hypr:affirm:writeOidcClientConfig.

  • Read (GET list, GET by id): One of scope: hypr:cc:applications (with principal = CC_ADMIN_RPAPP_ID), scope: hypr:affirm:admin, scope: hypr:affirm:readOidcClientConfig, or scope: hypr:affirm:writeOidcClientConfig.

Response and Error Format

  • Success responses use Content-Type: application/json. Client secrets are redacted (replaced with a placeholder) in all responses.

  • Errors use Content-Type: application/problem+json (RFC 7807). Typical status codes: 400 (Bad Request), 401 (Unauthorized), 403 (Forbidden), 404 (Not Found), 500 (Internal Server Error).

Related Documentation

  • Verification Flows API overview – Attach an OIDC config to a flow via oidcClientConfigId.

  • Individual endpoint docs: Get all, Create, Get by ID, Update (PATCH), Delete (OIDC Client Config API Postman).

Endpoint

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/results/activityLog

Returns a paginated list of identity verification activity log entries. Results are filtered by creation time between startTSUTC and endTSUTC. An optional search term is matched against workflowId, requester, approver, workflowType, and workflowCode.

Authentication

Type: Bearer token

  • Required scope (one of):

Header Required Value
Authorization Yes Bearer

Query parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
startTSUTC long Yes Start of time range (UTC epoch milliseconds).
endTSUTC long Yes End of time range (UTC epoch milliseconds).
term string No Search term; matches workflowId, requester, approver, workflowType, workflowCode.
pageNumber integer No Page number (1-based). Default: 1.
pageSize integer No Number of items per page. Default: 20.
orderBy string No Sort field. Default: createdAt.
sortDir string No Sort direction: asc or desc. Default: desc.
rpAppsIds string/list No Filter by RP app ID(s).

Response

Content-Type: application/json

Response body schema

{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "workflowId": "string",
      "workflowCode": "string",
      "requester": "string",
      "approver": "string",
      "createdAt": 0,
      "updatedAt": 0,
      "verificationFlowId": 0,
      "workflowType": "ONBOARDING | RECOVERY | CC_ADMIN | CUSTOM",
      "decision": "APPROVED | DENIED | NOT_ASSOCIATED",
      "status": "IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | ABANDONED | EXPIRED | ERROR | NOT_STARTED",
      "startTime": 0,
      "endTime": 0,
      "durationMs": 0,
      "workflowRequestSource": "API | UI | HELPDESK",
      "initiatedBy": "string",
      "workflowStepResults": {
        "phoneOrEmailStep": {},
        "locationStep": {},
        "verifiedCredentialStep": {},
        "idvStep": {},
        "photoIdAndLivenessStep": {},
        "approverChatAndVideoStep": {},
        "attestationStep": {},
        "outcomeStep": {}
      }
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "totalRecords": 0,
    "totalPages": 0,
    "pageSize": 0,
    "currentPage": 0
  }
}

Field descriptions

data — Array of activity log objects.

Field Type Description
id number Internal activity log ID.
workflowId string Workflow instance ID.
workflowCode string Human-readable workflow code.
requester string User undergoing verification.
approver string Approver of the verification (if any).
createdAt number Creation time (epoch ms).
updatedAt number Last update time (epoch ms).
verificationFlowId number ID of the verification flow.
workflowType enum ONBOARDING, RECOVERY, CC_ADMIN, CUSTOM.
decision enum Final decision: APPROVED, DENIED, NOT_ASSOCIATED.
status enum Workflow execution state: IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ABANDONED, EXPIRED, ERROR, NOT_STARTED.
startTime number Workflow start time (epoch ms). Null if not started.
endTime number Workflow end time (epoch ms). Null if still in progress.
durationMs number Total workflow duration in milliseconds. Null if not completed.
workflowRequestSource enum Source that initiated the workflow: API, UI, HELPDESK.
initiatedBy string Identifier of the user or system that initiated this workflow.
workflowStepResults object Step-level results. See workflowStepResults fields below.

workflowStepResults fields — Each step object may contain startTime, endTime, durationMs, status, errorStatusCode, errorMessage, and step-specific fields.

Step Key step-specific fields
phoneOrEmailStep smsSendTime, otpVerified, phoneNumberVerified, emailVerified, otpMedium
locationStep locationAcquired, ipLocation, browserLocation, ipListCheck, distanceThresholdCheck, countryBlockListCheck, matchedIpRule
verifiedCredentialStep verifiedCredentialVerified, verifiedAt

metadata — Pagination.

Field Type Description
totalRecords integer Total number of matching records.
totalPages integer Total number of pages.
pageSize integer Page size used.
currentPage integer Current page number (1-based).

Status codes

Code Description
200 OK. Response body contains data and metadata.
400 Bad Request. Invalid query parameters (e.g. missing startTSUTC/endTSUTC).
401 Unauthorized. Authentication required.
403 Forbidden. Insufficient permissions.
500 Internal Server Error. Unexpected server error.

Notes

  • startTSUTC and endTSUTC must be UTC epoch milliseconds.
  • When term is provided, only entries matching the term in the searchable fields are returned.

item.description:
Overview

The Affirm Helpdesk Workflows API provides endpoints for listing and retrieving identity verification (IDV) helpdesk workflow activity. Use these to get a paginated list of workflow runs (e.g. for the last 24 hours) or the full activity log for a single workflow by ID.

Base path: {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/helpdesk (workflow activity under /workflows)

Endpoints

Method Endpoint Description
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/helpdesk/workflows List workflow activity logs with pagination and optional search
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/helpdesk/workflows/{workflowId} Get a single workflow's activity log by workflow ID

List Workflows

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/helpdesk/workflows

Returns a paginated list of activity log entries. The time range is not supplied by the client: the server uses a tenant-configured rolling window (helpdeskRecordTimeWindowHours, ending at “now”; often 24 hours). Query parameters: optional term, pageIndex, pageSize, orderBy, sortDir. When term is provided, search runs across workflowId, requester, approver, workflowType, and workflowCode.

Get Workflow by ID

GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/helpdesk/workflows/{workflowId}

Returns the full activity log for one workflow. Path parameter workflowId is the workflow instance ID. Returns 404 or error if not found (behavior may vary by implementation).

Authentication

All endpoints require a Bearer token. Required scope (one of), matching AffirmApiAuthorizationExpressions.ACTIVITY_LOG_READ on the API controller:

  • scope: hypr:cc:applications (with principal = CC_ADMIN_RPAPP_ID)

  • scope: hypr:affirm:admin

  • scope: hypr:affirm:readAffirmActivityLog

Response and Error Format

  • Success responses use Content-Type: application/json. List returns data (array of activity log objects) and metadata (pagination). Get by ID returns a single activity log object.

  • Errors use Content-Type: application/problem+json (RFC 7807). Typical status codes: 400 (Bad Request), 401 (Unauthorized), 403 (Forbidden), 404 (Not Found), 500 (Internal Server Error).

Related Documentation

  • IDV Results API – Alternative activity log listing with explicit date range (/cc/api/idv/results/activityLog).

  • Individual endpoint docs: List workflows, Get workflow by ID (Affirm Helpdesk Workflows API Postman).

item.description:
Overview

The Policy Evaluation Kits API provides endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting policy evaluation kits. Policy evaluation kits define rule-based policies that are evaluated at specific workflow action points to determine step outcomes (pass/fail/escalate).

Base path: {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits

Note: This API requires a paid Affirm plan and the Policy Engine feature to be enabled.

Endpoints

Method Endpoint Description
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits/defaults Get default policy evaluation kit
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits/risk-signals List all available risk signals
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits/risk-signals/{actionName} Get risk signals for a specific workflow action
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits List all policy evaluation kits
GET {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits/{kitId} Get a policy evaluation kit by ID
POST {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits Create a new policy evaluation kit
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits/{kitId} Update an existing policy evaluation kit
PUT {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits/{kitId}/duplicate Duplicate a policy evaluation kit
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits/{kitId} Delete a policy evaluation kit by ID
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/idv/policy-evaluation-kits Delete all policy evaluation kits

Authentication

All endpoints require a Bearer token and one of the following scopes:

  • Read (GET): scope: hypr:cc:applications, scope: hypr:affirm:admin, or scope: hypr:affirm:readPolicyEvaluationKit
  • Write (POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE): scope: hypr:cc:applications, scope: hypr:affirm:admin, or scope: hypr:affirm:writePolicyEvaluationKit

Key concepts

  • Kit: A named collection of action policies. Each kit has a kitId, displayName, and activeVersion.
  • Action policies: Rules mapped to specific WorkflowActionName values. Each policy has a list of PolicyRuleDto objects.
  • Policy rule: A predicate (field condition or AND/OR combination) plus a verdict (PASS or FAIL) and an optional failure action.
  • Risk signals: The fields available for use in predicates, grouped by workflow action.

Field Type Description

request.description:
Endpoint

POST {{baseUrl}}/cc/api/bulk/fetch

Bulk extract API used to query supported entities (tables). This document describes one specific request: fetching IDV activity log rows with a filter and pagination.

Authentication

Type: Bearer token

Required: scope: hypr:rp:report with principal = CC_ADMIN_RPAPP_ID (Control Center admin RP app).

Request Headers

Header Required Value
Content-Type Yes application/json
Authorization Yes Bearer

Request Body (IDV activity log example)

Content-Type: application/json

Use the following body to fetch IDV activity log rows with the listed fields, filter (id > 0), and pagination.

{
    "target": {
        "subject": "idvactivitylog",
        "fields": [
            "id",
            "workflowId",
            "requester",
            "approver",
            "createdAt",
            "updatedAt",
            "verificationFlowId",
            "workflowType",
            "decision",
            "workflowStepResults"
        ],
        "filter": {
            "args": [
                {
                    "filter": {
                        "op": "GT",
                        "fieldRef": "id",
                        "literal": "0"
                    }
                }
            ]
        }
    },
    "pagination": {
        "page": 0,
        "rows": 10
    }
}

Request body fields (for this example)

Section Field Description
target Query target (entity and options).
target.subject string Entity to query. Use idvactivitylog for IDV activity log (maps to table idv_activity_log).
target.fields array of string Fields to return: id, workflowId, requester, approver, createdAt, updatedAt, verificationFlowId, workflowType, decision, workflowStepResults.
target.filter object Optional filter. Here: one condition in args[].filter with op (e.g. GT), fieldRef (field name), literal (value). GT = greater than; use "literal": "0" to return rows with id > 0.
pagination Required when you want rows back (omit for count-only).
pagination.page integer Zero-based page index. 0 = first page.
pagination.rows integer Number of rows per page. Min: 1. Example: 10.

  • Filter structure: Top-level filter has args, each element is an operand: either filter (single condition: op, fieldRef, literal) or relop (nested AND/OR/NOT with more args). This example uses a single condition: id GT 0.

  • Other filter ops: LT, EQ, LIKE (for text; use % in literal as needed). Combiners: AND, OR, NOT in a relop.

Response

When the request is valid and pagination is present, the response includes a list of result rows.

Content-Type: application/json

Response body schema

{
    "status": "string",
    "count": 0,
    "cost": 0,
    "results": [
        {
            "id": 0,
            "workflowId": "string",
            "requester": "string",
            "approver": "string",
            "createdAt": 0,
            "updatedAt": 0,
            "verificationFlowId": 0,
            "workflowType": "string",
            "decision": "string",
            "workflowStepResults": {}
        }
    ]
}
Field Type Description
status string "ok" when the request was valid; otherwise an error indication.
count long Present when the request had no pagination (count-only query). Total number of rows that would be returned.
cost long Cost of the request (used for throttling).
results array of object When pagination was sent: one object per row; keys match target.fields.

Each item in results has the fields requested in target.fields (e.g. id, workflowId, requester, approver, createdAt, updatedAt, verificationFlowId, workflowType, decision, workflowStepResults). Types follow the entity (e.g. numbers, strings, timestamps, nested object for workflowStepResults).

Status codes

Code Description
200 OK. Response body contains status, optional count/cost, and results when pagination was provided.
400 Bad Request. Invalid request body (e.g. invalid subject, fields, or filter).
401 Unauthorized. Authentication required.
403 Forbidden. Requires HYPR_RP_REPORT with CC_ADMIN_RPAPP_ID.
429 Too Many Requests. Throttled (bulk export rate/cost limit).
500 Internal Server Error. Unexpected server error.

Notes

  • This doc describes only the request shape above for idvactivitylog. The bulk fetch API supports other entities and request shapes; see bulk introspect endpoints or implementation for the full model.

  • Subject name is idvactivitylog (bulk/entity name), not the table name idv_activity_log.

  • To get more pages, repeat the same request with pagination.page = 1, 2, … and same pagination.rows.

  • If pagination is omitted, the API returns a count only (count set, no results).

HYPR Affirm collects personally identifiable information (PII) for the purpose of identifying and authenticating a person. request.description:
Added in HYPR version 11.1

Summary

Create a new email template.

Status Codes

201 Created
Indicates success.

An RFC7807 formatted error will be returned when a request cannot be completed.

Request Body Parameters

{
    "templateName": "<string>",
    "templateDescription": "<string>",
    "notificationType": "<string>"
}

templateName

The name of the template.

templateDescription

A description of the template.

notificationType

The type of notification this template will be used for. The Control Center sends different types of notifications depending on the action being performed on the app. Below are the notification types available and a description of their usage:

  • General Notifications

    • CONTROL_CENTER_USER_INVITE - An invite sent to a user to register an account for the HYPR Control Center.

    • CONTROL_CENTER_USER_RECOVERY - Sent to the owner of a registered account in the HYPR Control Center in order to recover lost access.

  • HYPR Affirm Notifications

    • AFFIRM_APPROVER_INVITE - An invite sent to a user to join an Affirm workflow as an approver.

    • AFFIRM_HELPDESK_USER_INVITE - An invite sent to a user to register an account for the Affirm Helpdesk application.

    • AFFIRM_HELPDESK_USER_RECOVERY - Sent to the owner of a registered account in the Affirm Helpdesk application in order to recover lost access.

    • AFFIRM_OTP - Provides an OTP to a requester to verify their email address.

    • AFFIRM_WORKFLOW_INVITE - An invite sent to a user to complete a new Affirm workflow.

  • Integration Notifications

    • AUTH_INTEGRATION_USER_INVITE - An invite sent to a user to register a device for a non-SSO HYPR Integration (e.g. Radius).

    • AUTH_INTEGRATION_USER_RECOVERY - Sent to the owner of a registered account in a non-SSO HYPR Integration in order to recover lost access.

    • ENTRA_NATIVE_INTEGRATION_USER_INVITE - An invite sent to a user to register a device for an Entra Native HYPR Integration.

    • INTEGRATION_USER_INVITE - An invite sent to a user to register a device for an SSO HYPR Integration.

    • INTEGRATION_USER_RECOVERY - Sent to the owner of a registered account in an SSO or Entra Native HYPR Integration in order to recover lost access.

  • Device Manager Notifications

    • DEVICE_MANAGER_NEW_DEVICE - Sent to a user when they register a new device in the Device Manager.

Response Body

{
  "id": "<string>",
  "templateName": "<string>",
  "templateDescription": "<string>",
  "notificationType": "<string>",
  "createdBy": "<string>",
  "createdAt": <integer>,
  "updatedAt": <integer>,
  "versions": [
    {
      "versionId": "<string>",
      "versionName": "<string>",
      "customizationType": "<string>",
      "createdBy": "<string>",
      "createdAt": <integer>,
      "updatedAt": <integer>
    }
 ]

id

The ID of the new template.

templateName

The name of the template.

templateDescription

A description of the template.

notificationType

The type of notification this template will be used for.

createdBy

Who created the template.

createdAt

Unix timestamp of when the template was created.

updatedAt

Unix timestamp of when the template was last updated.

versions

The list of versions of this template. Each version object will have the following parameters:

  • versionId - The ID of this version

  • versionName - The name of this version

  • customizationType [SIMPLE | ADVANCED] - The type of customization allowed for this version

  • createdBy - Who created the version.

  • createdAt - Unix timestamp of when the version was created.

  • updatedAt - Unix timestamp of when the version was last updated.

  • paddingRight - The right spacing of the module container.

  • paddingBottom - The bottom spacing of the module container.

    • text - The button text.

    • columns - An object containing the configuration for each single column. It contains the following parameters:

    • columnPadding - The spacing between columns.

    • layout - A comma-delimited set of integers that sets the number of columns and the size for each column. Each integer represents a column and the value determines how much space that column will take in the parent column module.

autoGenerateTextContent [TRUE | FALSE]

If TRUE, the text version of the email will be auto generated based off the content of a SIMPLE customized email. If FALSE, the text content will have to be changes manually. This will always be FALSE for ADVANCED customized emails.

htmlContent

The HTML content of the email template

textContent

The plaintext version of the email. If autoGenerateTextContent is TRUE, this will automatically update whenever the template is updated. Any manual changes will be discarded.

htmlSizeKB

The size (in kilobytes) of the rendered version of the HTML template content.

createdBy

Who created the template version.

createdAt

Unix timestamp of when the template version was created.

updatedAt

Unix timestamp of when the template version was last updated.

    • assetUrl - The URL of the image.

  • TEXT

    • content - The actual text content. Has some minimal HTML support.

    • color - The color of the text.

    • textAlign [LEFT | CENTER | RIGHT] - The alignment of the text

  • BUTTON

    • backgroundColor -The background color of the button.

    • textColor - The text color of the button.

    • fontSize - The font size of the button text.

    • fontWeight - The font weight of the button text.

    • buttonPaddingTop - The top spacing of the button.

    • buttonPaddingLeft - The left spacing of the button.

  • COLUMN

    • columns - An object containing the configuration for each single column. It contains the following parameters:

      • modules - The list of modules in this column. Can include any module except COLUMN modules.

    • columnPadding - The spacing between columns.

    • layout - A comma-delimited set of integers that sets the number of columns and the size for each column. Each integer represents a column and the value determines how much space that column will take in the parent column module.

autoGenerateTextContent [TRUE | FALSE]

If TRUE, the text version of the email will be auto generated based off the content of a SIMPLE customized email. If FALSE, the text content will have to be changes manually. This will always be FALSE for ADVANCED customized emails.

htmlContent

Only usable for ADVANCED customization types

The HTML content of the email template

textContent

The plaintext version of the email. If autoGenerateTextContent is TRUE, this will automatically update whenever the template is updated. Any manual changes will be discarded.

htmlSizeKB

The size (in kilobytes) of the rendered version of the HTML template content.

createdBy

Who created the template version.

createdAt

Unix timestamp of when the template version was created.

request.description:
Added in HYPR version 11.1

Summary

Update an email template version.

Status Codes

200 OK
Indicates success.

An RFC7807 formatted error will be returned when a request cannot be completed.

Request Body Parameters

      "paddingTop": <integer>,
      "paddingLeft": <integer>,
      "paddingRight": <integer>,
      "paddingBottom": <integer>,
      "width": <integer>,

}

versionId

The ID of the version being updated.

versionName

The name of the version.

customizationId

The ID of the parent template.

customizationType [SIMPLE | ADVANCED]

The type of customizations allowed for this version. If this is modified in an existing version, the content of the email may change based on the modification being made.

globalContent

Only usable for SIMPLE customization types

An object containing custom content set outside the main email body. It contains the following parameters:

  • subject - The subject of the email

globalStyle

Only usable for SIMPLE customization types

An object containing custom styles applied globally to all modules or to the email layout. It contains the following parameters:

  • contentWidth - The width of the inner container of the email body

  • textColor - The color of text in the email

  • linkColor - The color of links in the email

  • outerBackgroundType [SINGLE | GRADIENT] - Sets the type of background used in the outer container of the email.

    • SINGLE - The background of the outer container of the email will be a single color set from outerBackgroundColor.

    • GRADIENT - The background of the outer container of the email will be a gradient set from outerBackgroundColor.

  • outerBackgroundColor - An object containing the color configuration of the outer container background. It contains the following parameters:

    • color1 - A CSS color value. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this will be the background color of the outer container. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the topmost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the leftmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

    • color2 - A CSS color value. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value will be ignored. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the bottommost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the rightmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

    • direction [TOP_BOTTOM | LEFT_RIGHT] - If outerBackgroundType is set to GRADIENT, this will be the direction of the gradient. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value is ignored.

  • outerPaddingTop - The amount of spacing between the top of the outer container and the top of the inner container or topmost header module.

  • outerPaddingLeft - The amount of spacing between the left of the outer container and the left of the inner container.

  • outerPaddingRight - The amount of spacing between the right of the outer container and the right of the inner container.

  • outerPaddingBottom - The amount of spacing between the bottom of the outer container and the bottom of the inner container.

  • innerBackgroundType [SINGLE | GRADIENT] - Sets the type of background used in the inner container of the email.

    • SINGLE - The background of the inner container of the email will be a single color set from innerBackgroundColor.

    • GRADIENT - The background of the inner container of the email will be a gradient set from innerBackgroundColor.

  • innerBackgroundColor - An object containing the color configuration of the inner container background. It contains the following parameters:

    • color1 - A CSS color value. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this will be the background color of the inner container. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the topmost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the leftmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

    • color2 - A CSS color value. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value will be ignored. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the bottommost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the rightmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

    • direction [TOP_BOTTOM | LEFT_RIGHT] - If innerBackgroundType is set to GRADIENT, this will be the direction of the gradient. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value is ignored.

  • innerPaddingTop - The amount of spacing between the top of the inner container and the topmost body module.

  • innerPaddingLeft - The amount of spacing between the left of the inner container and the left of email body.

  • innerPaddingRight - The amount of spacing between the right of the inner container and the right of the email body.

  • innerPaddingBottom - The amount of spacing between the bottom of the inner container and the bottommost body module.

  • innerBorderRadius - The roundness of the corners of the inner container.

modules

Only usable for SIMPLE customization types

Modules are used to manage the actual content of an email for SIMPLE customization types. Modules contain the following parameters:

  • type [IMAGE | TEXT | BUTTON | COLUMN] - The type of module. The module type will determine the content and options available to configure in the module.

    • IMAGE - Used to display an image.

    • TEXT - Used to display text.

    • BUTTON - Used to display button-shaped links.

    • COLUMN - A layout module that enables a user to display modules in a column like structure

  • placement [HEADER | BODY | COLUMN] - Where the module will be placed in the module.

    • HEADER - Module will be placed at the top of the email, outside the inner container.

    • BODY - Module will be placed inside the inner container.

    • COLUMN - Module is nested inside a COLUMN type module.

  • paddingTop - The top spacing of the module container.

  • paddingLeft - The left spacing of the module container.

  • paddingRight - The right spacing of the module container.

  • paddingBottom - The bottom spacing of the module container.

  • width - The width of the module container.

The following parameters are available for specific module types:

  • IMAGE

    • alt - The alt text for the image

    • imageWidth - The width of the image.

    • assetUrl - The URL of the image.

    • link - An anchor link for the image. Enables a user to add links to an email through images.

  • TEXT

    • content - The actual text content. Has some minimal HTML support.

    • color - The color of the text.

    • textAlign [LEFT | CENTER | RIGHT] - The alignment of the text

  • BUTTON

    • backgroundColor -The background color of the button.

    • textColor - The text color of the button.

    • fontSize - The font size of the button text.

    • fontWeight - The font weight of the button text.

    • buttonPaddingTop - The top spacing of the button.

    • buttonPaddingLeft - The left spacing of the button.

    • buttonPaddingRight - The right spacing of the button.

    • buttonPaddingBottom - The bottom spacing of the button.

    • textDecoration - A CSS value to set the text decoration of the button text.

    • borderRadius - The roundness of the button corners.

    • text - The button text.

    • url - The anchor link for the button.

  • COLUMN

    • columns - An object containing the configuration for each single column. It contains the following parameters:

      • modules - The list of modules in this column. Can include any module except COLUMN modules.

    • columnPadding - The spacing between columns.

    • layout - A comma-delimited set of integers that sets the number of columns and the size for each column. Each integer represents a column and the value determines how much space that column will take in the parent column module.

autoGenerateTextContent [TRUE | FALSE]

If TRUE, the text version of the email will be auto generated based off the content of a SIMPLE customized email. If FALSE, the text content will have to be changes manually. This will always be FALSE for ADVANCED customized emails.

htmlContent

Only usable for ADVANCED customization types

The HTML content of the email template

textContent

The plaintext version of the email. If autoGenerateTextContent is TRUE, this will automatically update whenever the template is updated. Any manual changes will be discarded.

    • color2 - A CSS color value. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value will be ignored. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the bottommost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the rightmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

    • direction [TOP_BOTTOM | LEFT_RIGHT] - If outerBackgroundType is set to GRADIENT, this will be the direction of the gradient. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value is ignored.

  • outerPaddingTop - The amount of spacing between the top of the outer container and the top of the inner container or topmost header module.

  • outerPaddingLeft - The amount of spacing between the left of the outer container and the left of the inner container.

  • outerPaddingRight - The amount of spacing between the right of the outer container and the right of the inner container.

  • outerPaddingBottom - The amount of spacing between the bottom of the outer container and the bottom of the inner container.

  • innerBackgroundType [SINGLE | GRADIENT] - Sets the type of background used in the inner container of the email.

    • SINGLE - The background of the inner container of the email will be a single color set from innerBackgroundColor.

    • GRADIENT - The background of the inner container of the email will be a gradient set from innerBackgroundColor.

    • color1 - A CSS color value. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this will be the background color of the inner container. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the topmost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the leftmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

  • innerPaddingLeft - The amount of spacing between the left of the inner container and the left of email body.

  • innerPaddingRight - The amount of spacing between the right of the inner container and the right of the email body.

  • innerPaddingBottom - The amount of spacing between the bottom of the inner container and the bottommost body module.

modules

    • BODY - Module will be placed inside the inner container.

    • COLUMN - Module is nested inside a COLUMN type module.

  • paddingLeft - The left spacing of the module container.

  • paddingRight - The right spacing of the module container.

  • paddingBottom - The bottom spacing of the module container.

  • width - The width of the module container.

request.description:
Added in HYPR version 11.1

Summary

Generate the rendered HTML content for an email template for previewing.

Status Codes

200 OK
Indicates success.

An RFC7807 formatted error will be returned when a request cannot be completed.

Request Body Parameters

{
  "customizationType": "<string>",
  "globalContent": {
    "subject": "<string>"
  },
  "globalStyle": {
    "contentWidth": <integer>,
    "textColor": "<string>",
    "linkColor": "<string>",
    "outerBackgroundType": "<string>",
    "outerBackgroundColor": {
      "color1": "<string>",
      "color2": "<string>",
      "direction": "<string>"
    },
    "outerPaddingTop": <integer>,
    "outerPaddingLeft": <integer>,
    "outerPaddingRight": <integer>,
    "outerPaddingBottom": <integer>,
    "innerBackgroundType": "<string>",
    "innerBackgroundColor": {
      "color1": "<string>",
      "color2": "<string>",
      "direction": "<string>"
    },
    "innerPaddingTop": <integer>,
    "innerPaddingLeft": <integer>,
    "innerPaddingRight": <integer>,
    "innerPaddingBottom": <integer>,
    "innerBorderRadius": <integer>
  },
  "modules": [
    {
      "type": "IMAGE",
      "placement": "<string>",
      "paddingTop": <integer>,
      "paddingLeft": <integer>,
      "paddingRight": <integer>,
      "paddingBottom": <integer>,
      "width": <integer>,
      "alt": "<string>",
      "imageWidth": <integer>,
      "assetUrl": "<string>",
      "link": "<string>"
    },
    {
      "type": "TEXT",
      "placement": "<string>",
      "paddingTop": <integer>,
      "paddingLeft": <integer>,
      "paddingRight": <integer>,
      "paddingBottom": <integer>,
      "width": <integer>,
      "content": "<string>",
      "color": "<string>",
      "textAlign": "<string>"
    },
    {
      "type": "BUTTON",
      "placement": "<string>",
      "paddingTop": <integer>,
      "paddingLeft": <integer>,
      "paddingRight": <integer>,
      "paddingBottom": <integer>,
      "width": <integer>,
      "backgroundColor": "<string>",
      "textColor": "<string>",
      "fontSize": <integer>,
      "fontWeight": <integer>,
      "buttonPaddingTop": <integer>,
      "buttonPaddingLeft": <integer>,
      "buttonPaddingRight": <integer>,
      "buttonPaddingBottom": <integer>,
      "textDecoration": "<string>",
      "borderRadius": 4,
      "text": "<string>",
      "url": "<string>"
    },
    {
      "type": "COLUMN",
      "placement": "<string>",
      "paddingTop": <integer>,
      "paddingLeft": <integer>,
      "paddingRight": <integer>,
      "paddingBottom": <integer>,
      "width": <integer>,
      "columns": [
         {
            "modules": [...]
         }
      ],
      "columnPadding": <integer>,
      "layout": "<string>"
    }
  ],
  "autoGenerateTextContent": <boolean>,
  "htmlContent": "<string>",
  "textContent": "<string>",
  "injectAttributes": <boolean>,
  "templateAttributes": <map>
}

customizationType [SIMPLE | ADVANCED]

The type of customization

globalContent

Only usable for SIMPLE customization types

An object containing custom content set outside the main email body. It contains the following parameters:

  • subject - The subject of the email

globalStyle

Only usable for SIMPLE customization types

An object containing custom styles applied globally to all modules or to the email layout. It contains the following parameters:

  • contentWidth - The width of the inner container of the email body

  • textColor - The color of text in the email

  • linkColor - The color of links in the email

  • outerBackgroundType [SINGLE | GRADIENT] - Sets the type of background used in the outer container of the email.

    • SINGLE - The background of the outer container of the email will be a single color set from outerBackgroundColor.

    • GRADIENT - The background of the outer container of the email will be a gradient set from outerBackgroundColor.

  • outerBackgroundColor - An object containing the color configuration of the outer container background. It contains the following parameters:

    • color1 - A CSS color value. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this will be the background color of the outer container. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the topmost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the leftmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

    • color2 - A CSS color value. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value will be ignored. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the bottommost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the rightmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

    • direction [TOP_BOTTOM | LEFT_RIGHT] - If outerBackgroundType is set to GRADIENT, this will be the direction of the gradient. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value is ignored.

  • outerPaddingTop - The amount of spacing between the top of the outer container and the top of the inner container or topmost header module.

  • outerPaddingLeft - The amount of spacing between the left of the outer container and the left of the inner container.

  • outerPaddingRight - The amount of spacing between the right of the outer container and the right of the inner container.

  • outerPaddingBottom - The amount of spacing between the bottom of the outer container and the bottom of the inner container.

  • innerBackgroundType [SINGLE | GRADIENT] - Sets the type of background used in the inner container of the email.

    • SINGLE - The background of the inner container of the email will be a single color set from innerBackgroundColor.

    • GRADIENT - The background of the inner container of the email will be a gradient set from innerBackgroundColor.

  • innerBackgroundColor - An object containing the color configuration of the inner container background. It contains the following parameters:

    • color1 - A CSS color value. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this will be the background color of the inner container. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the topmost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the leftmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

    • color2 - A CSS color value. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value will be ignored. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the bottommost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the rightmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

    • direction [TOP_BOTTOM | LEFT_RIGHT] - If innerBackgroundType is set to GRADIENT, this will be the direction of the gradient. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value is ignored.

  • innerPaddingTop - The amount of spacing between the top of the inner container and the topmost body module.

  • innerPaddingLeft - The amount of spacing between the left of the inner container and the left of email body.

  • innerPaddingRight - The amount of spacing between the right of the inner container and the right of the email body.

  • innerPaddingBottom - The amount of spacing between the bottom of the inner container and the bottommost body module.

  • innerBorderRadius - The roundness of the corners of the inner container.

modules

Only usable for SIMPLE customization types

Modules are used to manage the actual content of an email for SIMPLE customization types. Modules contain the following parameters:

  • type [IMAGE | TEXT | BUTTON | COLUMN] - The type of module. The module type will determine the content and options available to configure in the module.

    • IMAGE - Used to display an image.

    • TEXT - Used to display text.

    • BUTTON - Used to display button-shaped links.

    • COLUMN - A layout module that enables a user to display modules in a column like structure

  • placement [HEADER | BODY | COLUMN] - Where the module will be placed in the module.

    • HEADER - Module will be placed at the top of the email, outside the inner container.

    • BODY - Module will be placed inside the inner container.

    • COLUMN - Module is nested inside a COLUMN type module.

  • paddingTop - The top spacing of the module container.

  • paddingLeft - The left spacing of the module container.

  • paddingRight - The right spacing of the module container.

  • paddingBottom - The bottom spacing of the module container.

  • width - The width of the module container.

The following parameters are available for specific module types:

  • IMAGE

    • alt - The alt text for the image

    • imageWidth - The width of the image.

    • assetUrl - The URL of the image.

    • link - An anchor link for the image. Enables a user to add links to an email through images.

  • TEXT

    • content - The actual text content. Has some minimal HTML support.

    • color - The color of the text.

    • textAlign [LEFT | CENTER | RIGHT] - The alignment of the text

  • BUTTON

    • backgroundColor -The background color of the button.

    • textColor - The text color of the button.

    • fontSize - The font size of the button text.

    • fontWeight - The font weight of the button text.

    • buttonPaddingTop - The top spacing of the button.

    • buttonPaddingLeft - The left spacing of the button.

    • buttonPaddingRight - The right spacing of the button.

    • buttonPaddingBottom - The bottom spacing of the button.

    • textDecoration - A CSS value to set the text decoration of the button text.

    • borderRadius - The roundness of the button corners.

    • text - The button text.

    • url - The anchor link for the button.

  • COLUMN

    • columns - An object containing the configuration for each single column. It contains the following parameters:

      • modules - The list of modules in this column. Can include any module except COLUMN modules.

    • columnPadding - The spacing between columns.

    • layout - A comma-delimited set of integers that sets the number of columns and the size for each column. Each integer represents a column and the value determines how much space that column will take in the parent column module.

autoGenerateTextContent [TRUE | FALSE]

If TRUE, the text version of the email will be auto generated based off the content of a SIMPLE customized email. If FALSE, the text content will have to be changes manually. This will always be FALSE for ADVANCED customized emails.

htmlContent

Only usable for ADVANCED customization types

The HTML content of the email template

textContent

The plaintext version of the email. If autoGenerateTextContent is TRUE, this value will be ignored.

templateAttributes

A map of values that will be used to replace attribute placeholders in the template.

injectAttributes [TRUE | FALSE]

If TRUE, all attributes in the template will be replaced with the values defined in templateAttributes. If FALSE, all attribute placeholders will remain as is.

Response Body

{
  "renderedHtml": "<string>",
  "renderedText": "<string>",
  "htmlSizeKB": <integer>
}

renderedHtml

A string containing the generated HTML from the template payload.

renderedText

A string containing the generated plaintext from the template payload.

htmlSizeKB

The size (in kilobytes) of the rendered HTML.

Added in HYPR version 11.1

Summary

Generates and sends a test email using the provided template payload.

Status Codes

200 OK
Indicates success.

An RFC7807 formatted error will be returned when a request cannot be completed.

Request Body Parameters

{
  "recipientAddresses": ["<string>"],
  "templateDetails": {
    "customizationType": "<string>",
    "globalContent": {
      "subject": "<string>"
    },
    "globalStyle": {
      "contentWidth": <integer>,
      "textColor": "<string>",
      "linkColor": "<string>",
      "outerBackgroundType": "<string>",
      "outerBackgroundColor": {
        "color1": "<string>",
        "color2": "<string>",
        "direction": "<string>"
      },
      "outerPaddingTop": <integer>,
      "outerPaddingLeft": <integer>,
      "outerPaddingRight": <integer>,
      "outerPaddingBottom": <integer>,
      "innerBackgroundType": "<string>",
      "innerBackgroundColor": {
        "color1": "<string>",
        "color2": "<string>",
        "direction": "<string>"
      },
      "innerPaddingTop": <integer>,
      "innerPaddingLeft": <integer>,
      "innerPaddingRight": <integer>,
      "innerPaddingBottom": <integer>,
      "innerBorderRadius": <integer>
    },
    "modules": [
      {
        "type": "IMAGE",
        "placement": "<string>",
        "paddingTop": <integer>,
        "paddingLeft": <integer>,

templateDetails

The template configuration to use to generate the email content. It contains the following parameters:

  • customizationType [SIMPLE | ADVANCED] - The type of customization

  • globalContent (Only usable for SIMPLE customization types) - An object containing custom content set outside the main email body. It contains the following parameters:

    • subject - The subject of the email

  • globalStyle (Only usable for SIMPLE customization types) - An object containing custom styles applied globally to all modules or to the email layout. It contains the following parameters:

    • contentWidth - The width of the inner container of the email body

    • textColor - The color of text in the email

    • linkColor - The color of links in the email

    • outerBackgroundType [SINGLE | GRADIENT] - Sets the type of background used in the outer container of the email.

      • SINGLE - The background of the outer container of the email will be a single color set from outerBackgroundColor.

      • GRADIENT - The background of the outer container of the email will be a gradient set from outerBackgroundColor.

    • outerBackgroundColor - An object containing the color configuration of the outer container background. It contains the following parameters:

      • color1 - A CSS color value. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this will be the background color of the outer container. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the topmost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the leftmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

      • color2 - A CSS color value. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value will be ignored. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the bottommost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the rightmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

      • direction [TOP_BOTTOM | LEFT_RIGHT] - If outerBackgroundType is set to GRADIENT, this will be the direction of the gradient. If outerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value is ignored.

    • outerPaddingTop - The amount of spacing between the top of the outer container and the top of the inner container or topmost header module.

    • outerPaddingLeft - The amount of spacing between the left of the outer container and the left of the inner container.

    • outerPaddingRight - The amount of spacing between the right of the outer container and the right of the inner container.

    • outerPaddingBottom - The amount of spacing between the bottom of the outer container and the bottom of the inner container.

    • innerBackgroundType [SINGLE | GRADIENT] - Sets the type of background used in the inner container of the email.

      • SINGLE - The background of the inner container of the email will be a single color set from innerBackgroundColor.

      • GRADIENT - The background of the inner container of the email will be a gradient set from innerBackgroundColor.

    • innerBackgroundColor - An object containing the color configuration of the inner container background. It contains the following parameters:

      • color1 - A CSS color value. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this will be the background color of the inner container. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the topmost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the leftmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

      • color2 - A CSS color value. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value will be ignored. If set to GRADIENT, this will be the bottommost color if direction is set to TOP_BOTTOM or the rightmost color if direction is set to LEFT_RIGHT.

      • direction [TOP_BOTTOM | LEFT_RIGHT] - If innerBackgroundType is set to GRADIENT, this will be the direction of the gradient. If innerBackgroundType is set to SINGLE, this value is ignored.

    • innerPaddingTop - The amount of spacing between the top of the inner container and the topmost body module.

    • innerPaddingLeft - The amount of spacing between the left of the inner container and the left of email body.

    • innerPaddingRight - The amount of spacing between the right of the inner container and the right of the email body.

    • innerPaddingBottom - The amount of spacing between the bottom of the inner container and the bottommost body module.

    • innerBorderRadius - The roundness of the corners of the inner container.

  • modules (Only usable for SIMPLE customization types) - Modules are used to manage the actual content of an email for SIMPLE customization types. Modules contain the following parameters:

    • type [IMAGE | TEXT | BUTTON | COLUMN] - The type of module. The module type will determine the content and options available to configure in the module.

      • IMAGE - Used to display an image.

      • TEXT - Used to display text.

      • BUTTON - Used to display button-shaped links.

      • COLUMN - A layout module that enables a user to display modules in a column like structure

    • placement [HEADER | BODY | COLUMN] - Where the module will be placed in the module.

      • HEADER - Module will be placed at the top of the email, outside the inner container.

      • BODY - Module will be placed inside the inner container.

      • COLUMN - Module is nested inside a COLUMN type module.

    • paddingTop - The top spacing of the module container.

    • paddingLeft - The left spacing of the module container.

    • paddingRight - The right spacing of the module container.

    • paddingBottom - The bottom spacing of the module container.

    • width - The width of the module container.

  • The following parameters are available for specific module types:

    • IMAGE

      • alt - The alt text for the image

      • imageWidth - The width of the image.

      • assetUrl - The URL of the image.

      • link - An anchor link for the image. Enables a user to add links to an email through images.

    • TEXT

      • content - The actual text content. Has some minimal HTML support.

      • color - The color of the text.

      • textAlign [LEFT | CENTER | RIGHT] - The alignment of the text

    • BUTTON

      • backgroundColor -The background color of the button.

      • textColor - The text color of the button.

      • fontSize - The font size of the button text.

      • fontWeight - The font weight of the button text.

      • buttonPaddingTop - The top spacing of the button.

      • buttonPaddingLeft - The left spacing of the button.

      • buttonPaddingRight - The right spacing of the button.

      • buttonPaddingBottom - The bottom spacing of the button.

      • textDecoration - A CSS value to set the text decoration of the button text.

      • borderRadius - The roundness of the button corners.

      • text - The button text.

      • url - The anchor link for the button.

    • COLUMN

      • columns - An object containing the configuration for each single column. It contains the following parameters:

        • modules - The list of modules in this column. Can include any module except COLUMN modules.

      • columnPadding - The spacing between columns.

      • layout - A comma-delimited set of integers that sets the number of columns and the size for each column. Each integer represents a column and the value determines how much space that column will take in the parent column module.

  • autoGenerateTextContent [TRUE | FALSE] - If TRUE, the text version of the email will be auto generated based off the content of a SIMPLE customized email. If FALSE, the text content will have to be changes manually. This will always be FALSE for ADVANCED customized emails.

  • htmlContent (Only usable for ADVANCED customization types) - The HTML content of the email template.

  • textContent - The plaintext version of the email. If autoGenerateTextContent is TRUE, this value will be ignored.

  • templateAttributes - A map of values that will be used to replace attribute placeholders in the template.

  • injectAttributes [TRUE | FALSE] - If TRUE, all attributes in the template will be replaced with the values defined in templateAttributes. If FALSE, all attribute placeholders will remain as is.

request.description:
Added in HYPR version 11.1

Summary

Get the revisions for a single template version through a search request.

Status Codes

200 OK
Indicates success.

An RFC7807 formatted error will be returned when a request cannot be completed.

Path Parameters

templateId

The ID of the parent template.

versionId

The ID of the version.

Query Parameters

pageNumber

The page number to fetch.

pageSize

The number of items to retrieve per page.

orderBy

The payload key to sort by.

sortDir [asc | desc]

The sort order direction.

Response Body

{
    "data": {
        "customizationId": "<string>",
        "versionId": "<string>",
        "revisions": [
            {
                "id": "<string>",
                "createdBy": "<string>",
                "createdAt": <long>
            }
        ]
    },
    "metadata": {
        "totalRecords": <integer>,
        "totalPages": <integer>,
        "pageSize": <integer>,
        "currentPage": <integer>
    }
}

data

The result of the search request. It contains the following parameters:

  • customizationId - The ID of the parent template.

  • versionId - The ID of the version.

  • revisions - The list of revisions found in the request. It contains the following parameters:

    • id - The ID of the revision.

    • createdBy - Who made this revision.

    • createdAt - When this revision was made.

metadata

Details about the search request. It contains the following parameters:

  • totalRecords - The total number of revisions found.

  • totalPages - The total number of pages of records available based on the page size.

  • pageSize - The number of records found on this paged request.

  • currentPage - The current page returned from this request.

request.description:
If no username is provided, returns a paginated list of RP application users; If a username is provided, it returns information about the specified RP application user. The access token determines the affected RP application.

The Bearer Token determines the affected RP application; this may be the controlCenterAdmin token.

Added in HYPR version 6.7.0.

Status Codes

200 OK

Request Parameters

page
The number of the page you want to return from the paginated list of users. You can only get one page per request and by default the first page is returned.

size
The number of RP Users to include on each page in the result set. The default is 20.

sort
The RP User property by which to sort the output. This can be any property name and by default the output will be returned in descending order. The property can be optionally surrounded by desc() or asc() to change the order of the sort, for example asc(username). By default this is set to desc(dateCreated).

username
Return data only for the RP application user specified by this username.

version
The current default version is 4.

Response Body

{
  "data": [],
  "metadata": {}
}

The response is a single page from the paginated list of RP Users returned by the search, along with associated response metadata.

data
An array of RP User Objects matching the search criteria (specified by the username parameter), or all RP User Objects if no search criteria was specified. See RP User Object below. data will be empty if no RP application user matches the search criteria.

metadata
Informational data related to the response, such as the total number of records, page size, or page number. See RP User Response Metadata below.

RP User Object

{
  "username": "string",
  "dateCreated": "<datetime>",
  "lastActive": "<datetime>",
  "devices": [],
  "smartKey": [],
  "firstname": "string",
  "lastname": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "source": "string",
  "role": "string",
  "hasAuditTrailAccess": boolean
}

Each RP User Object contains information for that user. data in the Response Body is an array of these RP User Objects. Each RP User Object consists of the following:

username
The RP User's username. For Workstation RP Applications, this is the username of the user which is used to log in. For Web RP Applications, this is the email address of the user.

dateCreated
The first time (UTC) the RP application user has registered the device to the workstation or web. This is specified in Unix Epoch timestamp format.

lastActive
